title: Allow `composes` inside `@layer`?
impact: Anyone wrapping CSS module rules in @layer (common with Tailwind v4-style layer setups) or @media/@supports. 4 thumbs-up; a CSS modules contributor (kizu) agreed it should work and noted tooling/visitors that wrap modules in a layer break `composes`. Workaround exists (move composes to an unlayered rule).
summary: `composes` in a plain class rule inside @layer, @media or @supports errors with 'cannot be used within nested rules', in both pretty and minify mode. The check is Printer::is_nested(), which is just `indent > 2`, so any enclosing block counts, not only an enclosing style rule. The reference implementation (postcss-modules-scope, used by css-loader and Vite's default CSS modules) only rejects composition when an ancestor is a style rule and allows it inside at-rules.
repro: 761-repro.mjs. `@layer components { .foo { composes: bar; color: red } } .bar{}` -> 'ERROR: The `composes` property cannot be used within nested rules' on local, 1.33.0, 1.32.0, 1.31.1 (also @media, @layer+@media, `from './other.module.css'`). Controls: top-level composes works; composes in a nested style rule `.x { .foo { composes: bar } }` still errors.
evidence: scripts/repro.mjs on local + 1.31.1..1.33.0 (all error) and --all (errors in every release that parses the input; before 1.22.0 the nested-style-rule control failed to parse). Read postcss-modules-scope 3.2.1 src/index.js (npm tarball): isNestedRule() walks parents and returns true only if a parent is type 'rule'; at-rules are skipped, so composes in @layer/@media is allowed there.

fix.approach: Replace the indent-based `dest.is_nested()` test with a real 'inside a style rule' signal, e.g. a counter on Printer incremented by StyleRule::to_css around its nested rules (dest.context() is not enough: it is unset when nesting is printed natively). Keep the error for composes under a parent style rule. Add tests in src/lib.rs css_modules tests for @layer/@media/@supports, pretty and minify.

notVerified: Did not build a fix. Behavior with nesting lowered (targets without nesting support) for composes in a nested style rule not re-checked beyond the control case.
